The '''"Bug Smasher" Shield''' was a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|device]] used to create a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. It was created by [[BGRE]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
